name: uproad
description: Turn a client brief into a prototype and a spec, share one link the client can open without an account, and fold their comments back in.

api_token.title: Uproad API token
api_token.description: Create a personal token at https://uproad.design/settings/personal-tokens (any member; starts with upu_). It reaches every workspace you belong to. A workspace token (up_, admins only) also works but reaches one workspace.

api_url.title: Uproad URL
api_url.description: Only change this if you run Uproad somewhere else.
